body: internal/http/handlers/agents.go: AgentsHandler serves GET /api/v1/agents (list all, filter ?type=emily_cluster) and GET /api/v1/agents/{id} (by ID or name). Requires JWT auth. openapi.go: agents paths added to spec. main.go: /api/v1/agents + /api/v1/agents/ wired with RequireAuth. ColabEmily registers as EMILY_PRIME_COLAB_<cluster_id> type=emily_cluster — now visible in IDUNA /admin/agents and queryable via /api/v1/agents?type=emily_cluster from Emily Prime monolith.
title: S44-04: GET /api/v1/agents endpoint + distributed Emily self-identification
